BrochureContent.Content:
Homes in Meadow Court rarely come to the market, and No. 3 offers a fantastic opportunity to secure a spacious five-bedroom family home in this mature and established residential estate.

Located in a quiet cul-de-sac, this turnkey home offers generous and versatile accommodation throughout. The ground floor features two separate reception rooms, a bright sunroom and one of the five bedrooms, offering excellent flexibility for guests, a home office or additional family space.

Upstairs, there are a further four well-proportioned bedrooms, while the property benefits from three bathrooms in total, making it an ideal layout for a growing family.

To the rear, the south-facing garden is a real highlight, enjoying plenty of natural light throughout the day and providing a great space for outdoor dining, entertaining or simply relaxing.

Presented in turnkey condition, this is a home where the next owners can simply move in and enjoy.

Lauradell is a mature residential area, conveniently located within easy reach of Waterford City, schools, shops and a range of local amenities.

With five bedrooms, multiple living spaces, a south-facing garden and turnkey condition, No. 3 Meadow Court offers the space and flexibility that modern family life demands in a location where homes rarely become available.
